class.name: IfcAirTerminalBox
class.brief_description: An air terminal box typically participates in an HVAC duct distribution system and is used to control or modulate the amount of air delivered to its downstream ductwork. An air terminal box type is often referred to as an "air flow regulator". HISTORY New entity in IFC2x4 Type Use Definition IfcAirTerminalBox defines the occurrence of any air terminal box; common information about air terminal box
